class.name: LayoutManager
class.brief_description: Abstract base for layout strategies (linear / grid / staggered).
class.description:
LayoutManager is the port of [i]RecyclerView.LayoutManager[/i]. It defines the layout strategy used to position items and to decide which positions are visible. You normally use one of its concrete subclasses ([b]LinearLayoutManager[/b], [b]GridLayoutManager[/b], [b]StaggeredGridLayoutManager[/b]) rather than subclassing this class in GDScript.
[b]Note:[/b] [method get_content_size] and [method get_position_offset] are bound on this base class but overridden by the concrete managers internally; calling them from GDScript returns the base-class default (0). Use [method LinearLayoutManager.get_item_offset] or the managers' row/column queries when you need geometry from a script.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size along the scroll axis. Base default is 0; the concrete managers compute it internally.

method.name: get_item_count
method.description: Returns the adapter's item count (0 when no adapter is set).

method.name: get_position_offset
method.description: Returns the item's starting scroll offset in content space. Base default is 0.

method.name: get_recycler_view
method.description: Returns the [b]RecyclerView[/b] this layout is attached to.

method.name: get_reverse_layout
method.description: Returns whether reverse layout is enabled.

method.name: set_reverse_layout
method.description: Enables reverse layout: items are laid out from the trailing end (bottom for a vertical list). Combined with an initial scroll to the max offset this gives a chat list where position 0 sits at the bottom.
